description: Open departure times and booking status for one tour on one date, from the American Ghost Walks booking system. Times are local to the tour. Check this before telling a guest a time is open; if it says availability is unknown or lists no times, send the guest to the booking link instead of guessing.

date.description: Single local calendar date to check, as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-11-08'). Must be today or a future date in the tour's time zone.

party_size.description: Optional number of guests (integer 1-50). When set, only departures that can fit this party are listed as open.

tour.description: Tour identifier from search_tours.tour_id (preferred slug, e.g. 'madison-ghost-walks-capitol-square'), or the exact tour name.

name: get_availability
title: Check tour availability
